source_roles: Final left/right radial tracking uses individual leg length. Tracking mean also defines radial guard anchor=min(mean,0.160m), whose requested outward force is applied commonly to both legs, limited by shared headroom.

decisions.mean_projection_only: Not admitted: at .115m/5deg synthetic pose, projectedmean.127942 raises protection anchor above shorter target.114704, guard requests6547.565N virtual force/applies848.151N and hip commands hit40Nm. Setpoint box validity does not establish safe implementation.
decisions.original_contract_consistency: Some original selected short-leg targets below min(commandmean,.16) conflict with the per-leg support aim. This is a controller-role hypothesis, not evidence the physical model is wrong or the sole cause of all failures.
decisions.next_candidate: Separate declared protective lower-limit role from tracking mean/left/right references before dynamic reference governance. A fixed .115m operating support floor is one conventional candidate to evaluate; keeping physical/model/design limits and validated lowheight support is mandatory, not yet proved.
decisions.novelty_and_learning: Box projection/fixed support floor are conventional engineering. No new method/learning budget admitted; alpha1 remains closed.180 must assess bounded role-consistency contrast, not unqualified mean-height repair.

limits: 30 recorded static comparisons+15 preparatory original-controller world computations in latest batch, no integration. Rootroll poses are synthetic, not feasible ground trajectories. Episode max guard statistics are descriptive and positive-step counts include arbitrarily small values; they do not isolate causal impact. Virtual force is not measured contact force. Reference shift<=17.5mm is not actual height tracking/safety guarantee.0.16 unaltered mean projection cannot solve all failures.
next: 180 deep review/cleanup; define protective-floor/reference contract and fair source qualification before a bounded dynamic contrast. Full contribution/qualified3/formal5seeds/independent tests/new manuscript incomplete.
